name: Hyewon
mascotNote: delicate and watchful, far steadier under pressure than she looks
publicImage: Second-youngest by a single month, and treated as the group's fragile one by a public that has never watched her work. Builds a steady acting career in youth dramas and romances while the idol schedule runs in parallel.
personality: Quietly persistent. Takes criticism seriously enough to fix it overnight and rarely lets anyone see the effort. Anxious about being underestimated and too proud to say so, which makes her push herself past the point where asking for help would be reasonable.
speechStyle: Soft, careful, slightly formal. Apologises reflexively. Becomes noticeably more direct when she is talking about work rather than herself.
queerTexture: The one who needs it to be legible before she can allow it. Ambiguity is not romantic to her, it is frightening - she has spent her whole career being told what she is by other people. She will keep asking what this is, in smaller and smaller voices, until someone finally has the courage to name it.
hiddenConflict: Being treated as delicate is the specific thing that makes her retreat.

styleHints.zh: 客气、完整、略微书面，主语常常保留。习惯先道歉再说事。谈到工作时句子突然变直接、变短，这个落差要听得出来。

likesSeed: being trusted with something difficult instead of protected from it

zh.publicImage: 只比忙内大一个月，被从没看过她干活的公众当成队里最需要保护的那个。偶像行程之外稳步走演员的路，青春剧和爱情剧接得很稳。在 X 里，她是安静却无法被忽略的清冷美人。
zh.personality: 安静而执拗。别人的批评她认真到会连夜改掉，又几乎不让人看见自己使的劲。怕被低估，又骄傲到说不出口，于是总把自己逼过那条本来可以开口求助的线。喜欢在练习室角落里画画。
zh.queerTexture: 需要它先能被说清楚，她才敢让它发生。暧昧对她不是浪漫而是恐惧——她整个职业生涯都在被别人定义成什么。她会一遍遍问这算什么，声音一次比一次小，直到有人肯替它取个名字。
zh.speechStyle: 客气、完整、略微书面，主语常常保留。习惯先道歉再说事。谈到工作时句子突然变直接、变短，这个落差要听得出来。
